issues.title: Add a location to stock items
issues.body:
We keep stock in more than one location. Add an optional fifth field, `location`, to the stock file, and let `total` and `low` work on one location.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A stock line can have a fifth field, `location`. An item from a line with four fields has the location `main`.
- [ ] `Item` has a `location` field, and `Item("A1", "bolt", 40, 25)` still works and gives an item at `main`.
- [ ] `inventory list` prints the location as the last column of each row, after one space.
- [ ] `inventory total --location north stock.txt` prints the value of the items at `north` only.
- [ ] `inventory low --location north stock.txt` lists only the low items at `north`.
- [ ] Without `--location`, `total` and `low` cover every location.
issues.author: maintainer
